bugs.error_message: _clone_config wrote literal secrets to cloned configs
bugs.root_cause: _clone_config applied source data and overrides, then validated only with ModelConfig before writing. It skipped validate_config_payload, so literal secrets from the source config or clone overrides bypassed the shared secret block.
bugs.fix: Run validate_config_payload on the finalized clone payload before any clone write; raise invalid-config with validation details and write no destination file when literal secrets are present.

bugs.error_message: Backend evidence gate silently skipped renamed Blackbird FP8 configs
bugs.root_cause: validate_backend_evidence returned checked=false for any config_name without a registered rule, even when the provided config had the Blackbird docker FP8 shape that requires backend evidence validation.
bugs.fix: Fail closed for unregistered docker FP8 configs that match the Blackbird image or FlashInfer SM120 arch marker, reject registered-rule runs whose config.name differs from the rule key, and require the validated 60 GiB FP8 KV reservation.

bugs.error_message: Named onboarding failures rendered generic prose without exact remediation commands
bugs.root_cause: The transport and discovery paths returned named TargetCallError codes, but CLI and TUI rendering used generic fallback text, so operators did not see target-specific bootstrap, setup-ssh, or build-doctor commands.
bugs.fix: Add a shared remediation map and route CLI/TUI rendering for command-not-found, agent-unreachable, version-mismatch, and uv-required through target-specific command templates with captured SSH stderr; add a runnable build doctor command for the uv-required remediation.

bugs.error_message: targets bootstrap only wrote a target record and did not install, verify, or build
bugs.root_cause: The bootstrap command was a thin targets-add variant: it discovered an existing agent if present, wrote targets.yaml, and printed a static success line without managed install, handshake verification, or optional build creation.
bugs.fix: Add a transport-level SSH install helper, wire bootstrap --install to retry discovery after managed install, print a green/red-style handshake summary, and support --build as a default pip build creation after onboarding.

bugs.error_message: build inspect error path dereferenced target.name when target was a string option
bugs.root_cause: The build_inspect error handler passed target_name=target.name, but target is the Typer option string, so TargetCallError paths crashed with AttributeError before rendering remediation.
bugs.fix: Pass target_name=target and add an error-path regression asserting SSH auth remediation renders for build inspect --target blackbird.

bugs.error_message: doctor was local-only and always emitted static onboarding next steps
bugs.root_cause: _doctor_payload only checked local targets.yaml parsing and controller token state, then unconditionally returned bootstrap and gen-token next steps even when the setup was healthy.
bugs.fix: Add --target doctor support backed by an agent-side diagnose RPC, render target connection/version/paths/toolchain/auth checks, discover SSH agent commands when needed, and make next_steps conditional on actual failures.

bugs.error_message: target path and toolchain truth was only visible through doctor
bugs.root_cause: After adding the diagnose RPC, targets test still printed only the handshake and agent status only inspected the local daemon socket, so operators could not quickly see the target host's resolved config/runs/builds/model/socket paths from those status surfaces.
bugs.fix: Reuse the agent diagnose report in targets test and agent status --target, render shared version/host/path/toolchain/auth lines, and document VELA_CONFIGS plus XDG_* path overrides.

bugs.error_message: setup-ssh remediation command was advertised but not implemented
bugs.root_cause: Agent-unreachable remediation surfaced `vela targets setup-ssh <name>` as the next operator action, but the targets command group had no setup-ssh command to run ssh-copy-id for the configured SSH target.
bugs.fix: Add a transport-level ssh-copy-id wrapper and wire `vela targets setup-ssh <name>` with optional --identity support plus a fake-binary CLI regression asserting the target key and host are passed through.

bugs.error_message: targets test handshake remediation rendered TargetConfig instead of target name
bugs.root_cause: Bootstrap and targets-test handshake error handlers passed the full TargetConfig object to the remediation renderer instead of the target's name string.
bugs.fix: Pass target.name for both handshake error paths and add a targets-test regression asserting setup-ssh remediation renders `blackbird` and not a Python object repr.

bugs.error_message: lab deployment recipe image could be overridden by compose input
bugs.root_cause: The Docker image resolver checked caller-provided runtime.image before the matched lab recipe image, so a known Blackbird FP8/BF16 recipe could silently lose its proven vLLM image digest while keeping the rest of the recipe shape.
bugs.fix: Prefer matched recipe images over caller-provided Docker image inputs and emit a recipe-image-override-ignored warning when an input image differs from the pinned recipe digest; add a regression for the Blackbird FP8 recipe.

bugs.error_message: agent token install was controller-local only for SSH targets
bugs.root_cause: `vela agent gen-token --install` wrote the controller's default token file but had no --target option or agent RPC to install the matching token on a remote SSH target.
bugs.fix: Add a write_agent_token RPC that installs the token into the target agent's default 0600 token file, wire `vela agent gen-token --install --target <name>` to install locally and remotely, and cover the real fake-SSH subprocess path.

bugs.error_message: target auth failures surfaced only as generic connection errors
bugs.root_cause: `vela doctor --target` appended target_auth only after diagnose succeeded, while handshake-time `agent-auth-required` failures returned only a target_connection failure and malformed controller tokens escaped as exceptions.
bugs.fix: Infer `required+missing`, `mismatch`, and `malformed-token` from agent-auth-required failures, append a target_auth doctor check with target-aware token-install remediation, and convert malformed controller token configuration into the named auth error path.

bugs.error_message: fresh uv pytest run could not import tests.fakes or conftest consistently
bugs.root_cause: The suite imported both `tests.fakes...` and `conftest` as top-level modules, but pytest did not explicitly put both the repo root and tests directory on sys.path in a newly created uv environment.
bugs.fix: Set pytest pythonpath to include both `.` and `tests`; avoid adding tests/__init__.py because making tests a package breaks existing top-level conftest imports.

bugs.error_message: target config edit round-trip was absent
bugs.root_cause: `vela config` exposed push, pull, and lint, but had no `config edit` command to pull target YAML through an editor, lint the edited result on the target, and push it back without manual SSH/file copying.
bugs.fix: Add `vela config edit <name> --target <name>` using pull_config, Typer's editor helper, lint_config, and push_config with name/overwrite enforcement; add tests for successful editor round-trip and lint refusal before push.

bugs.error_message: new deployment wizard could not create or adopt a build inline
bugs.root_cause: The primary TUI deployment wizard only offered process, docker, existing build, and executable runtimes, while the create-build and adopt-venv flows existed only in the standalone build manager.
bugs.fix: Add Create build and Adopt venv runtime handoffs to the wizard, capture and restore the wizard draft, reuse the existing CreateBuildScreen and AdoptBuildScreen, and resume New Deployment at Review with the returned build label/id pinned.

bugs.error_message: new deployment wizard lacked first-class model pin/adopt/download controls
bugs.root_cause: The model step only offered an existing pinned-model selector plus a bare model input, leaving HF repo pinning, local-path adoption, download-now behavior, and gated/cache state visible only in the standalone model manager.
bugs.fix: Add model source modes to New Deployment, reuse PinModelScreen for HF repo and local-path handoffs, run the existing download_model job when download-now is selected, resume the wizard with model_ref/revision pinned, and render cache/auth state for selected models.

bugs.error_message: new deployment wizard was fixed to the active target
bugs.root_cause: The target step rendered only static active-target text and the app always loaded composer inputs through the current target client, so the wizard could not choose another registered target before composing.
bugs.fix: Render a registered-target Select with connection-state text, route target changes through the normal app target-switch path, and reopen the wizard with the draft preserved so subsequent list/compose/preview RPCs use the selected target client.

bugs.error_message: flag manager lacked preset picker, reset-to-preset, and changed-only affordances
bugs.root_cause: The TUI reused FlagManager for deployment customization but only exposed build-default reset and a full modeled-flag list, leaving the v1 preset-level affordances absent.
bugs.fix: Add a preset Select, reset-to-selected-preset binding, and changed-only Checkbox to FlagManager; pass preset lists from the app when available; ignore initial same-value Select events so opening the modal never auto-applies a preset; keep preset switches scoped to engine fields.

bugs.error_message: new deployment model step did not show live agent-side deployment hints before review
bugs.root_cause: The wizard only surfaced composer suggestions after compose_config on the Review screen; it never called the dedicated suggest_deployment_defaults RPC when a model was selected or typed.
bugs.fix: Pass an optional suggestion resolver from the app to NewDeploymentScreen, call target-side suggest_deployment_defaults for registry pins and bare model text, and render engine hints plus warnings on the model step without mutating the draft.

bugs.error_message: new deployment save-and-smoke coverage did not exercise a fake docker lifecycle
bugs.root_cause: The wizard smoke test asserted the target RPC order with a mocked client, but did not prove the primary TUI flow could save a docker deployment through LocalAgent, launch it, observe READY, stop the docker sidecar, and wait to STOPPED.
bugs.fix: Add a LocalAgent/InProcess New Deployment fake-Docker Save & Smoke test and extend the fake docker helper with opt-in state-file wait behavior so the TUI stop branch can signal a live fake container.

bugs.error_message: save-and-smoke replaced named health failures with generic not-ready text
bugs.root_cause: The smoke path called _handle_health_changed with the agent error_kind, which set the ErrorKind banner and guidance, then immediately overwrote it with 'Smoke did not reach READY: ...' whenever ready was false.
bugs.fix: Preserve the ErrorKind banner when probe_until_ready returns a named error_kind, and only use the generic smoke-not-ready message for unclassified failures; add fake-Docker HF_AUTH smoke failure coverage.

bugs.error_message: Blackwell FP8 Docker composer path could look validated from metadata alone
bugs.root_cause: For non-recipe Docker deployments on Blackbird/P620 targets, model registry or Hugging Face config metadata could seed fp8 engine hints without surfacing that the required SM120 vLLM image, FlashInfer arch, CUTLASS/FlashInfer backend, and KV-cache shape still come from local validated deployment scripts.
bugs.fix: Warn with blackwell-fp8-runtime-recipe-required when a Blackwell-target Docker FP8 deployment lacks a matched lab recipe, while preserving the known Qwen FP8/BF16 local-script-derived recipes unchanged.

bugs.error_message: edit_config literal-secret guard lacked direct regression coverage
bugs.root_cause: The agent-side edit_config writer correctly validated the edited payload before writing, but no test drove an edit override that injected a literal server.api_key secret.
bugs.fix: Add a real edit_config RPC regression that injects server.api_key, asserts invalid-config with the secret-literal validation payload, and confirms the YAML file remains unchanged.

bugs.error_message: offline Hugging Face pins could not preserve unresolved remote-only intent and repo misses lacked named taxonomy
bugs.root_cause: pin_model treated network failures while resolving Hugging Face metadata as hard failures, so a user could not record a remote-only pin while offline, and the snapshot/model-info classifier did not name repository-not-found distinctly from broader model resolution failures.
bugs.fix: Allow network-classified HF metadata failures to write a remote_only pin with commit_sha null and structured warnings, keep prepare_launch blocking that unresolved pin until re-pinned online, and classify RepositoryNotFound errors as repo-not-found. Surface the structured warnings through CLI and TUI deployment review.

bugs.error_message: stale docker sidecar reattach leaked raw identity mismatch instead of named RPC failure
bugs.root_cause: stop and kill translated TrackedProcessMismatch into identity-verification-failed, but reattach/status loaded verified sidecars without translating the same mismatch. A recycled Docker container id or image digest would refuse safely, but through an unstructured Python exception at the agent boundary.
bugs.fix: Catch TrackedProcessMismatch in reattach/status and raise TargetCallError identity-verification-failed with run_id and sidecar_path details. Add fake-Docker fresh-agent discover/reattach coverage and recycled id/digest refusal tests.

bugs.error_message: deploy create silently overwrote existing configs and made --overwrite dead
bugs.root_cause: The deploy create CLI always sent overwrite=true to save_config, so a repeated create clobbered the target config even when the operator did not pass --overwrite.
bugs.fix: Only send overwrite when --overwrite is supplied, render config-exists with an explicit --overwrite hint, and print updated deployment for explicit overwrite saves.

bugs.error_message: remote validation parsed smoke run_id from a loose READY-line substring
bugs.root_cause: The remote backend-evidence gate extracted smoke_run_id with a sed expression over any line containing run_id=, coupling CI to incidental human-readable output formatting.
bugs.fix: Have smoke-tui emit a dedicated tab-delimited VELA_SMOKE_RUN_ID marker and parse that marker in run_remote_tests.sh before invoking backend_evidence_check.

bugs.error_message: unknown Blackwell FP8 Docker compose could still produce a launchable config
bugs.root_cause: The non-recipe Blackwell FP8 guard warned but still returned a composed Docker config. That could let model metadata stand in for the validated local deployment recipe that actually pins the SM120-compatible vLLM image, FlashInfer arch, CUTLASS/FlashInfer backend shape, and FP8 KV memory layout.
bugs.fix: Keep suggestion/default calls as warning-only, but make final compose_config raise blackwell-fp8-runtime-recipe-required unless the deployment matches a local lab recipe.

bugs.error_message: target manager lacked bootstrap and push-config affordances
bugs.root_cause: The TUI Target Manager could switch, add, edit, reconnect, and remove targets, but it did not expose the onboarding-spec P4 actions for showing a bootstrap command or pushing a selected local config to a remote target.
bugs.fix: Add Bootstrap and Push config target-manager actions. Bootstrap renders the exact controller CLI command without running SSH from the TUI; Push uses a temporary TargetClient to call the remote agent's push_config RPC with the selected local YAML.

bugs.error_message: remote no-GPU suite failed when localhost:8000 was occupied
bugs.root_cause: Several fake launch/preflight tests asserted command, event, or missing-executable behavior without setting server.port, so the launch preflight checked the product default port 8000 first. P620 had a local service on 127.0.0.1:8000, causing unrelated PORT_IN_USE failures before the intended behavior was exercised.
bugs.fix: Set pytest-provided free ports in the affected fake-launch YAML fixtures across agent-client, CLI, and TUI tests while leaving product defaults unchanged.

bugs.error_message: backend evidence checker could not inspect a cleanly stopped smoke run
bugs.root_cause: The remote validation lane ran `vela smoke-tui`, which intentionally stops the run after READY, then launched a fresh backend evidence checker that tried to `reattach` and `tail_detached` a no-longer-live run. The durable sidecar, manifest, and log still existed on the target, but there was no serializable agent RPC for reading that stopped-run artifact.
bugs.fix: Add an agent-side `read_run_artifact` RPC that resolves a run id from the target-local config runs_dir, reads the stopped sidecar/manifest/log on the agent, and returns serializable config plus log text. Switch backend_evidence_check.py to validate that artifact instead of requiring a live reattach.

bugs.error_message: Incorrect value in code
bugs.root_cause: Had `0259b1d`
bugs.fix: Changed to 's independent run + my pre-flight), **ruff clean*

bugs.error_message: Blackwell FP8 lab-recipe guard ignored explicit BF16 runtime overrides
bugs.root_cause: The guard that requires a matched local lab recipe for Blackwell FP8 Docker deployments ran before `_merge_overrides`, and its predicate treated an FP8 model-name or registry hint as decisive. An operator-pinned Docker image with `overrides.engine.kv_cache_dtype: bfloat16` was therefore rejected before the final runtime shape existed.
bugs.fix: Evaluate the guard after the payload has merged overrides and validated into `ModelConfig`. The predicate now checks the effective `--kv-cache-dtype` in appended extra args first, then final `engine.kv_cache_dtype`, and only falls back to FP8 model hints when no explicit runtime shape is set.

bugs.error_message: fake SSH harness could not isolate user-venv and python-module discovery probes
bugs.root_cause: The fake SSH candidate-probe branch returned one `FAKE_SSH_VELA_PATH` for every `candidate=... --version` probe, so tests could not prove that the canonical venv path was absent while the user venv path was present.
bugs.fix: Add independent fake remote state for canonical-venv, user-venv, and target-venv candidate probes, then add B1 regression tests for the user-venv fallback and `python3 -m vela` fallback.

bugs.error_message: target diagnose omitted CUDA, GPU architecture, and active build/model state
bugs.root_cause: The B4/B5 diagnose surface still returned only host paths, driver, Python, uv, and auth. The controller-side doctor therefore could not show target CUDA toolkit, GPU architecture, or active build/model state even though onboarding requires those agent-owned facts.
bugs.fix: Add agent-side serializable diagnose helpers for CUDA toolkit detection, GPU summary/architecture, and selected active build, render those fields in CLI target reports, and update the fake SSH harness/tests to cover the wire shape.

bugs.error_message: real Blackbird diagnose reported driver=None despite nvidia-smi exposing a driver
bugs.root_cause: `_driver_version()` only read the `NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION` environment variable. The Blackbird target did not set that env var, while `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version` correctly reported `580.159.03`.
bugs.fix: Keep the environment variable override, then fall back to a bounded agent-side `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader,nounits` probe and return the first reported driver version.

bugs.error_message: Blackbird BF16 native-Docker validation skipped backend evidence
bugs.root_cause: The backend evidence checker only registered the Qwen3.6 FP8 Blackbird rule. The BF16 native-Docker recipe therefore returned `BACKEND_EVIDENCE_SKIPPED` even though its Docker image, bfloat16 KV shape, and absence of FP8-only FlashInfer/KV-byte pins are also local recipe invariants.
bugs.fix: Add a BF16 Blackbird backend-evidence rule that checks the pinned image and bfloat16 KV shape while rejecting FP8-only `FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` and `--kv-cache-memory-bytes` drift.

bugs.error_message: Blackbird Qwen recipes carried a stale vLLM 0.11 profile label for a proven 0.20.2rc1/cu130 Docker stack
bugs.root_cause: The copied Blackbird launch shape used the correct pinned Docker image, cache mounts, FP8/BF16 memory shape, and backend flags, but recipe/config metadata still set `vllm.version_profile: 0.11`. That made the saved configs imply the wrong runtime stack even though the local deployment records prove vLLM 0.20.2rc1.dev9, Transformers 5.7.0, Torch 2.11.0+cu130, and CUDA 13.0.
bugs.fix: Add explicit vLLM stack provenance fields to the config schema, switch the Blackbird Qwen recipe/config profile hint to `current`, and record the proven vLLM/Transformers/Torch/CUDA stack in recipes, checked-in YAML, docs, and regression tests.

bugs.error_message: detached reattach failed when sidecar config snapshots serialized new optional vLLM provenance fields as null
bugs.root_cause: The detached supervisor sidecar snapshot dumped every optional config field. After adding vLLM provenance fields, snapshots included `vllm.version`, `vllm.transformers_version`, `vllm.torch_version`, and `vllm.cuda_version` as null. Out-of-process agents with an older or slimmer schema rejected those null keys while hydrating detached runs.
bugs.fix: Prune null values from detached config snapshots before redaction, while preserving the intentional scrubbed `server.api_key: null` marker, and add regression coverage for the vLLM snapshot shape plus detached reattach waits.

bugs.error_message: remote real-model resume/restart lane did not apply backend evidence after daemon restart
bugs.root_cause: A15 hardened the first real smoke run_id contract and backend gate, but the optional real resume/daemon-restart lane still ran `real_model_resume_check.py` without parsing its daemon-restart run id or reusing the backend evidence checker.
bugs.fix: Capture the real resume/restart output, parse the structured `REAL_MODEL_DAEMON_RESTART_OK run_id=...` marker, and run `backend_evidence_check.py` against the same config/run before the remote validation lane exits.

bugs.error_message: generic docker command builder emitted implicit --shm-size together with --ipc=host
bugs.root_cause: The Docker argv builder always computed and emitted a default shared-memory size, even when `ipc_host` was true. That diverged from the native-Docker spec template and made default configs noisier.
bugs.fix: Emit the computed default `--shm-size` only when host IPC is disabled, while still honoring explicit `command.docker.shm_size` values. Blackbird recipes keep their proven `--ipc=host --shm-size 32g` shape because they set `shm_size: 32g` explicitly.

bugs.error_message: tiny real-model resume validation failed on P620-to-Blackbird because the config required vllm on PATH
bugs.root_cause: The tiny resume config used process runtime and therefore launched `vllm` from the target PATH. The remote validation environment intentionally reported `vllm not found on PATH`, so the real resume lane failed before exercising the daemon-restart evidence gate.
bugs.fix: Convert the tiny resume config to native Docker using the pinned Blackbird vLLM image digest, target-local cache mounts, host networking, and current stack provenance so it no longer depends on a target PATH binary.

bugs.error_message: remote real-resume validation launched stale or schema-incompatible target-owned config copies after the controller repo was updated
bugs.root_cause: The remote validation lane pulled the controller repo on P620, but `real_model_resume_check.py --target blackbird` launched the config from Blackbird's target-owned config registry. That registry could still contain an older YAML after P620 pulled current HEAD, and older target agents rejected newly added advisory vLLM stack provenance fields during push_config.
bugs.fix: When `VELA_REMOTE_REAL_RESUME_CONFIG` names a checked-in YAML and `VELA_REMOTE_TARGET` is set, write a temporary compatibility copy that strips only advisory vLLM stack provenance fields, then push it to the selected target with `vela config push --overwrite` before launching resume/restart validation.

bugs.error_message: tiny real-resume restart validation exercised backend evidence plumbing but reported BACKEND_EVIDENCE_SKIPPED
bugs.root_cause: The remote restart lane called `backend_evidence_check.py` for `tiny-random-llama-detached-blackbird`, but the checker had no rule for that validation config and therefore skipped instead of proving the Docker image/runtime shape.
bugs.fix: Add a tiny Blackbird resume backend-evidence rule that verifies native Docker runtime and the pinned Blackbird image digest, with regression coverage for a checked OK result.

bugs.error_message: doctor reported active_model as none even when the agent had a verified live sidecar
bugs.root_cause: The diagnose active-state payload populated active_build from the build registry but left active_model as a hardcoded None stub instead of deriving it from verified agent-side sidecars.
bugs.fix: Derive active_model from verified live sidecars inside the target agent and return only serializable model/run fields for doctor rendering.

bugs.error_message: backend evidence checker silently skipped unregistered Blackbird BF16-shaped configs
bugs.root_cause: The fail-closed unregistered-config guard only recognized FP8 Blackbird shapes. A BF16 config using the pinned Blackbird Docker image and bfloat16 KV cache could be renamed and return BACKEND_EVIDENCE_SKIPPED.
bugs.fix: Add a BF16 Blackbird shape predicate so unregistered pinned-image bfloat16 KV configs raise a backend evidence error instead of skipping.

bugs.error_message: New Deployment target picker showed a static disconnected dot for non-active registry targets
bugs.root_cause: The wizard only received the active target connection state, so non-active registry rows were rendered as inactive/static even though C3 requires a connection dot for the registry picker. Textual Select mount behavior also made active-target defaulting dependent on registry order.
bugs.fix: Feed the wizard per-target connection rows, put the active target first, asynchronously probe non-active targets through short-lived TargetClient instances, and refresh the select options/details without triggering a target switch.
